description: Only when your user asked: sends a quote request for SEO, secure WordPress or a fixed-scope project to a person at Managed Nerds, who replies by email within one business day. No prices. Only the block matching service_line is used. Ad management is only sold with SEO. Returns a status: requested, needs_info (with what's missing), seo_required or outside_service_area. Managed IT and co-managed security go through preliminary_estimate then request_full_quote, and the free SEO check through request_seo_check.

state.description: US state, such as GA or SC

website.description: Website address, if it has one

notes.description: Anything else the user wants a person at Managed Nerds to know

project.description: For service_line project: which fixed-scope project

details.description: Answers to that project's quote_questions from list_projects

secure_wp.description: For service_line secure_wp: the WordPress site

dns_provider.description: Who runs the domain's DNS: GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare and so on

ecommerce.description: Whether the site takes online orders

hacked_before.description: Whether the site has been hacked before

seo.description: For service_line seo: how the site and search setup stand today

ad_budget.description: Monthly ad spend in dollars: the client's own budget with the ad platform

current_provider.description: Who does its SEO today, if anyone

goals.description: What the user wants from SEO

google_business_profile.description: Its Google Business Profile link or name

has_google_analytics.description: Whether Google Analytics is set up

has_search_console.description: Whether Google Search Console is set up

service_area.description: The towns or region it serves

wants_ads.description: Whether the user also wants ad management, which is only sold with SEO

service_line.description: What the quote is for. Fill the matching block below

user_approved.description: True only when the user asked for this

user_request.description: What the user asked for, in their words

name: request_service

free_seo_check.description: The free SEO check, for SEO requests

message.description: What happens next, in words to relay to the user

status.description: pending_confirmation (a confirm link is waiting for the user) or requested (a person has it)

title: Request a service quote
